description: This Mac's human device key (ADR-0146 개정 2026-09-28 R2-E5, #3025): the eight device_key_* commands — status, create the Secure Enclave key, bind the server's key id and pin it on this Mac's workd, and sign the three statements (control, device_endorse, device_revoke) and this Mac's own key move (device_rebind, #3103) after a native confirmation. The webview never passes bytes to sign. For the main window's own webview (label `main`) on the bundled (local) origin only, macOS only. No `remote` entry: a page from the network must never reach the signing key.
